name: Thunder Software Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Founded in Beijing, China, in 2008, Thunder Software Technology Co.,Ltd. is a global provider of intelligent operating system (OS) products and advanced technologies. The company specializes in mobile device software, offering differentiation services, carrier certification, automated testing, FOTA update solutions, hardware design, and comprehensive camera integration for platforms like Android, Windows, and Tizen. Furthermore, Thunder Software powers the Internet of Things (IoT) and smart device market with its TurboX Smart Core Platform, an open ecosystem comprising core system-on-modules, operating systems, SDKs, algorithms, development boards, and community support. Its diverse IoT portfolio includes end-to-end smart wearable solutions (covering cloud services, companion apps, and devices), a range of hardware such as Thundersoft TT_M3HQ and TT_M4G9 boards, Thundercomm TurboX AI kits, TurboX Tracker solutions, and the TurboX Asset Tag for asset monitoring. In the automotive sector, the company delivers intelligent cockpit software solutions, spanning OS development, core technology licensing, and custom application development for infotainment systems, digital dashboards, integrated cockpits, ADAS, and audio products.
